title: Signed Overflow Detector
statement: Create a signed overflow detector for 8-bit addition. The module should assert overflow whenever two operands and the result violate signed overflow rules. This is a common condition check in ALUs and arithmetic pipelines.
module_signature: module overflow_detector(input signed [7:0] a, input signed [7:0] b, input signed [7:0] sum, output overflow);
behavior: overflow is 1 when adding a and b produces a signed result outside [-128, 127].
overflow is 0 for all other cases.
Purely combinational: outputs must settle after input changes.
Do not depend on initial register values, clocks, or delays.
All outputs must be driven to known 0/1 values for every input case.
constraints: Do not use registers or sequential logic.
hint: Check if the operands have the same sign and the result has a different sign.
